## ChatOSS v1.16.0

The engine-improvement release that came out of the two-day OpenCode terminal-freeze investigation (fixed in v1.15.3), plus a full pre-release review pass.

### Observability & self-testing
- **Always-on webview error capture** — uncaught errors and unhandled rejections are recorded to a ring-buffered log, viewable in **Settings → Diagnostics**, via `chatoss debug errors`, and over `GET /debug/errors` on the local launch server. Error storms are deduplicated and rate-limited.
- **Terminal diagnostics** — per-session stats (chunks, bytes, painted vs. buffer rows, pending write-acks, DEC modes) and **kill attribution** (who killed a session and why) in Settings → Diagnostics; a `diagnose_terminal` tool for the Code agent; a write-ack watchdog that labels a wedged input bridge on the card instead of freezing silently.
- **Packaged-app self-test** (`chat-oss --self-test`) now gates every release: it spawns each installed coding CLI through the real launch pipeline at the real card size, requires a painted TUI in raw mode, a delivered task, zero captured errors, and replays 12 golden CLI boot-stream fixtures (including the exact wedged-session repro). Fully isolated from your running app's data.
- **Build fingerprint** in Settings → About (app version · build target · bundler) so a bug report says which build it came from.
- **Prod-parity harness** — CI now replays the golden fixtures through the *built, minified* bundle in a headless browser before any installer is produced.

### Code agent
- `run_command` gains a **background** option (`run_in_background`) with `check_background_task`, a **`monitor`** tool for non-blocking waits on files/processes/tasks, a per-project **`tmp/scratch/`** convention, and **`MEMORY.md`** surfaced at session start with an `append_memory` tool.
- **Secret redaction** on tool results and every "Copy chat" export (env dumps, tokens, keys, private-key blocks) — tuned so ordinary source code passes through byte-identical.
- New debugging doctrine in the system prompt: bug-report triage, differential testing, arm-errors-first, symptom- vs component-verified.

### Launch
- Per-launch **effort** (`chatoss launch <cli> --effort <level>`), batch spawns ask one question with per-agent overrides, and the CLI id is now the binary name (`claude`; `claude-code` still accepted).
- `chatoss launch … -- <args>` forwards everything after `--` verbatim.

### Fixes from the review pass
- Redactor no longer mangles source code (`token`, `secret`, `password` identifiers).
- Running the self-test while ChatOSS was open no longer breaks `chatoss launch` for the running app.
- Every terminal/PTY bridge await in a turn is time-bounded (build-time lint guards enforce it, plus a guard for blocking work on the async runtime).
- Kill attribution no longer holds the PTY registry lock while writing to SQLite; a panic inside a database closure no longer disables saving for the rest of the session; a late write can no longer reopen the database during quit.
- Concurrent launches no longer lose their effort records; an unknown launch handle falls back to the default model instead of an upstream "model not found".
- Windows: the process monitor matches CLIs that run under `node.exe`; the CI harness runs under cmd.exe.

After updating, reinstall the `chatoss` command from **Settings → Launch** if you use Launch mode from a terminal (the bundled CLI is refreshed with the app; a stale copy elsewhere on PATH is not).
